scope: Stage 3-B B3.2 HWPX portable clipboard fidelity follow-up

originalFailureConditions.fontFamily: An absent, throwing or malformed destination resolver could silently leave the destination default. The source display getter gave one primary family name.
originalFailureConditions.outline: The snapshot omitted lineType, so unsupported visible outlines could be reconstructed as a default solid outline.
originalFailureConditions.alignment: Unproven source alignment or a missing destination setter could be omitted.
originalFailureConditions.formatting: An incomplete range list could be accepted. A boolean-mask inventory can merge runs that differ in other properties. Engine cell offsets count Unicode scalar values and the caption atno owns one slot.

currentSupport.sameDocument: Existing HWPX structural clone and Stage 3-B SAFE Section0 HWP5 picture, basic shape, plain textbox and flat group clipboard.
currentSupport.portable: Validated HWPX picture (MIME and image bytes, up to 8 MiB), rectangle, ellipse, basic line and textbox. Patternless opaque solid or no fill, default-cap arrowless solid or no outline, verifiable geometry.
currentSupport.text: Paragraph text, order and proven alignment. Full run coverage excluding the single caption atno slot, with empty paragraphs allowed. Supported bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, size, color, shading and family.
currentSupport.fontFamily: An explicit family requires the same source name in all seven slots. Destination lookup or registration must return seven valid IDs pointing to the exact requested family, with round-trip formatting readback. A run with no explicit family retains its valid destination default.
currentSupport.transaction: Within the existing recoverable history mutation, reconstruction and character-shape compaction precede readback. A refusal restores the before snapshot including appended font definitions and objects. A failed rollback or engine trap retains the existing uncertain editing path.

remainingUnsupported: Cross-document HWP5 object paste and DOCX/HWP/HWPX cross-format object conversion
HWPX portable Group, Polygon, Curve, Chart, SmartArt and arbitrary OLE
Dotted, dashed and other unrepresentable outlines, unsupported line geometry, gradient/image or other unrepresentable fills
Nested controls, unproven ownership or resource references, unsupported text formatting and language-specific font mixtures
Incomplete or malformed portable data and orphan object-marker plain-text fallback

releaseWasm.command: node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts stage3-hwpx-clipboard-safety.wasm.test.ts stage3-object-edit.wasm.test.ts stage3-shapes.wasm.test.ts -t 'B3.2|portable refusals and rollback|retains same-document|routes missing MIME|owned HWP and HWPX shape captions|multi-paragraph captions|copies, cuts, and pastes HWPX body|edits the second existing paragraph of an owned hwpx text box|edits one owned HWPX text box'

cases: Missing font resolver, exception after actual font registration, short array, invalid ID and valid IDs for another family
Real HWPX DOT outline survives source reopen and is refused cross-document
Leading, interior and trailing gaps, overlaps, out-of-bounds ranges and invalid ordering in source and envelope
Unreadable source alignment, absent destination setter and destination setter returning ok without applying alignment
Missing ordinary text beside atno and a run crossing atno
Character-format setter returning ok without applying the requested run, forged picture MIME and orphan object marker
negative.sessionInvariants: No commit, revision or dirty change. Object identity/count, body, font inventory and serialized destination unchanged. No Undo/Redo entry.

cases: Plain and captioned picture with image bytes and crop preserved
Solid rectangle, ellipse and zero-width visible solid line, plus a no-outline rectangle with nonzero border width
Two caption paragraphs with atno ownership, alignment, bold and italic
Mixed textbox with a supplementary Unicode character, an empty paragraph, supported style runs and an explicitly registered font across seven slots
Destination default font for a payload without a family requirement
Cross-document Undo/Redo, independent export/reopen, source bytes unchanged and HWPX same-document structural clone

earlierHarnessAttempt.cause: The DOT fixture overlapped the caption selection and the run used the prior Release binary. The fixture was separated and the final run used a fresh build.
